newsitem.title: SPAIN: Barcelona cargo traffic up 5.4 pct in November.
newsitem.headline: Barcelona cargo traffic up 5.4 pct in November.

text.p: Cargo traffic at Spain's Barcelona airport rose 5.4 percent in November compared with the same month last year to 7,970 tonnes, the airport authority said.
The total for the first 11 months of 1996 now stands at 72,817 tonnes, 17.2 percent above the same period 1995.
International freight business is 28.6 percent higher in the year to date at 43,084 tonnes while domestic cargo is only 3.9 percent ahead of 1995 at 29,733 tonnes.

Passenger numbers were 20.9 percent higher in November at 1.0 million excluding transit passengers, taking the accumulated total to 11.96 million, a rise of 14.3 percent. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44-171-524-7706 Fax+44-171-542-5017
